roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse (RN)
description: Join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD, as a Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse. This vital full-time role offers an excellent opportunity to impact patient care and staff excellence within a supportive environment. We are actively seeking a dedicated professional to join our team.In this dual-focused position, you will be instrumental in both staff education and maintaining rigorous infection prevention standards. Your responsibilities will include developing and implementing comprehensive training programs for clinical staff, ensuring compliance with all regulatory requirements, and leading our infection control initiatives to safeguard the health of our residents and team members.We offer a competitive hourly rate of $40.00 - $42.00, commensurate with your experience. If you are a passionate RN ready to take on a challenging and rewarding role, we encourage you to apply today.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Minimum of 2 years of experience in staff development or education
Minimum of 2 years of experience in infection prevention and control
Strong knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations
Excellent communication, organizational, and leadership skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation: $40.00 - $42.00 per hour, based on experience.
